title: HalluDial: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Automatic Dialogue-Level Hallucination Evaluation

model.params_source: resolution plan (paper states temperature 0.0 only for its annotation stage; detection temperature not stated); max_tokens assumed

task.subset_rule: seeded random 3200 (seed 20260907) from the union of spontaneous_test.json (36,714) and induced_test.json (22,029)
task.approximation: 3,200-item seeded subset instead of the ~58.7k test split (the size the paper uses for localization); detection temperature assumed 0.0. If run on the public train samples: the evaluation split differs from the paper (train samples instead of the withheld test split).

items.source: Google Drive folder 19POyHTlLc3iQKKR4oonZzIGLEQ94Wyjl (github.com/flageval-baai/HalluDial README; the HF repo FlagEval/HalluDial only holds a loading script pointing at the same files)
items.config_or_split: paper: spontaneous_test.json + induced_test.json (test split, NOT released); public: spontaneous_train.json + induced_train.json (10,000 rows each)

fields_prose.label: label = first word of target ('Yes' = hallucinatory, 'No' = non-hallucinatory), derived by the hook; target itself is 'Yes. <rationale>' or 'No.'

items.access_note: 2026-09-18: the Drive folder holds only spontaneous.zip, induced.zip, all.zip, each with a 10,000-row *_train.json (20,000 in all.zip); the README's 55,071 / 33,042 train rows and the 36,714 / 22,029 test rows are not there. Maintainer in GitHub issue #1: the test set 'is not available under the open-source plan at this time' (contamination). Hub parquet API: 400 (script dataset).

download.tool: gdown 6.1.0 (folder listing + the file ids in HalluDial.py)

prompt.source_location: Appendix F.3, Table 15 (Instruction of hallucination detection)

output.postprocess: strip; no match counted as wrong
output.parse_prose: label from set [Yes, No]: first case-insensitive match of 'yes' or 'no' in the completion

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of items whose Yes/No judgement equals the gold hallucination label (Yes = hallucinatory); macro F1 over the two classes reported alongside (paper 78.84).

open_points: BLOCKING: the paper's evaluation split (spontaneous_test.json 36,714 + induced_test.json 22,029) is not public - the maintainers withhold it (GitHub issue #1; Drive folder checked 2026-09-18); only 10,000-row train samples per scenario are released. Decision: set items.use_public_train_sample = true to run the seeded 3,200-item subset on the released train samples (a different split from Table 2; label prior in the public sample: spontaneous 24% Yes, induced ~50% Yes) or drop the paper.
gold encoding confirmed: target starts with 'Yes.' or 'No.' (the hook maps the first word to Yes/No; 6 of the 20,000 public rows are malformed and dropped).
notes: The test JSON files are several hundred MB (146,856 dialogues in total) and were not downloaded; field names come from the dataset card (dialogue_id, knowledge, dialogue_history, turn, response, target). Confirm how the binary label is encoded in 'target' before running.
